hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom single-LP AMM backed by Euler Finance vault positions. All swap logic runs in beforeSwap: it takes input tokens, deposits them into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, and verifies the configurable price curve invariant — bypassing the standard Uniswap concentrated-liquidity mechanism entirely.
